predict.question: On a practice quiz, you get easy questions right 100% of the time and hard ones 50%. The quiz has two easy and eight hard questions. What is your expected score?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Mindset challenges treating present performance as a fixed limit on what someone can learn.
modelBoundary: Mostly easy yields {A}%; mostly hard {B}%. Only task weights change; neither group’s assumed accuracy changes.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? These invented scores measure no mindset intervention or future learning capacity.
